title: Industrial Nexus: Important Systems
summary: Read the Industrial Nexus signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Thermal tools, factory diagnostics, flux meters, coolant packs, and recipe cards all help identify whether a problem is heat, power, recipe lock, or inventory flow.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch machine state, recipe inputs, output space, heat or coolant pressure, power draw, throughput, and the one segment that limits the whole line.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A Industrial Nexus system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
